subject.title: fix(ui): keep Codex commentary visible after runs

question: Should existing profiles that never explicitly selected `chatPersistCommentary` switch from the prior hidden default to visible durable commentary on upgrade, or should that behavior be preserved while new installs receive the new default?
rationale: The diff deliberately changes an existing preference fallback, but it provides no migration or explicit upgrade contract for profiles where the setting was absent.

options.title: Preserve upgraded profiles
options.body: Keep the historical hidden behavior for existing unset profiles through an explicit upgrade path, while allowing a chosen fresh-install default.

options.title: Adopt the new default universally
options.body: Accept that upgraded unset profiles will begin displaying stored commentary and document that release-level behavior with upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve upgraded profiles
recommendation.body: Keep the historical hidden behavior for existing unset profiles through an explicit upgrade path, while allowing a chosen fresh-install default.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed branch defines the new durable transcript and preference semantics, making the author the closest available routing contact pending confirmed current-main ownership history.
